BO-38

BODY — Sun Roof

REMOVAL OF SUN ROOF

1. DISCONNECT BATTERY CABLE FROM NEGATIVE TERMINAL

2. REMOVE CENTER COVER OF CONTROL BOX

3. REMOVE CONTROL SWITCH

4. REMOVE DRIVE MOTOR THROUGH SERVICE HOLE

5. REMOVE WIND DEFLECTOR

6. REMOVE GUIDE RAIL COVER

7. REMOVE SLIDING ROOF AND GUIDE RAIL
(a) Apply adhesive tape to protect the body.
(b) Pull the sliding roof with the guide rail upward and forward to remove.

DISASSEMBLY OF SUN ROOF

1. REMOVE SLIDING ROOF HEADLINING
(a) Pry off the clip.
(b) Pull the sliding roof headlining rearward to remove.

2. REMOVE GUIDE RAIL AND CABLE GUIDE CASING
(a) Loosen the screw.
(b) Pull the guide rail rearward to remove.
(c) Pull the cable guide casing forward to remove.

3. NOTE NUMBER OF SHIMS ON FRONT AND REAR

4. REMOVE FRONT SHOE

5. REMOVE DRIVE CABLE AND REAR SHOE

6. REMOVE DRIVE CABLES FROM CABLE GUIDE CASING
